raw_segments.text: Pentheus? It bursts hard by us like a smothered fire this frenzy of bacchic women. All my
land has made their mock this needs an iron hand. Ho, captain! Quick to the Electron gate!
Bid gather all my menna-tarms there at! Call all that spur the charger, all who know to
wield the orb'd targe or bend the bow. We march to war, for God shall women dare such
deeds against us. Tease too much to bear.
